component.name: SuperShot
component.summary: Lightweight screenshot and annotation tool for Linux

description.p: SuperShot is a native, ultra-lightweight Linux screenshot taking and annotation application with a clean user interface, low memory footprint, system tray integration, and multi-tab image editing.

ul.li: Fullscreen, active window, and custom region screen capture
Color picker tool with hex and rgb clipboard copying
Rich annotation toolset: pen, highlighter, line, arrow, double arrow, rectangle, ellipse, badge counters, and borderless text labels
Area selection tool with move, copy, cut, crop, and white canvas deletion
Canvas expansion handles with pan and hand tool navigation
Pixelate and blur obfuscation tools for sensitive content
Fast startup and minimal system resource usage

description.p: Rebranded to SuperShot with refined Photoshop-style toolbar icons, perfectly balanced highlighter tool, and multi-format distribution (DEB, RPM, AppImage, Flatpak).

Photoshop toolbar icons across dark and light themes, including the iconic marquee selection tool, calligraphy fountain pen nib, water droplet blur tool, tilted paint bucket, eyedropper pipette, and classic serif type tool.

Pasted image resizing with 8 edge and corner handles, Photoshop-style crop workflow with interactive adjustments and rule-of-thirds grid, canvas-bounded annotations restricting writing and drawing to the image canvas, and 10% smaller system tray icon.

Right-click context menu copying in image editor, reliable Wayland and X11 clipboard integration for toolbar copy button, and exact screenshot boundary capture preventing extra canvas margins on HiDPI displays.
